column1: # Independent manifest of every systemd unit v3 requires a template for.
# Format: unit<TAB>source, where source is "generic" (bootstrap/units/) or
# HR-309: a product name must not be hard-coded into the generic mechanism).
# This file exists because a loop over bootstrap/units/*.in can only ever
# validate templates that happen to be there -- it has no opinion on a
# template that used to exist and silently isn't anymore. That is the
# 2026-08-01 incident (a canonical unit vanished and nothing noticed for two
# days) moved one layer up, from host to repository. Every entry here MUST
# have a matching <unit>.in file in its named source directory, checked by
# bootstrap/check-unit-drift.sh independently of what that directory happens
# to list. Absence is drift: named, non-zero exit (Hard Floor 7).
